items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Peele would be playing in those kind of places too? Zell? Yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, they played in those places too.

ctx.x: That's what I mean, Coochie. Well all them fellas, they didn't play much in bands, you know what I mean? Six piece, seven piece bands. They were in those cabalets and trucks in different places.
And Peele would be playing in those kind of places too? Zell? Yeah.
Yeah, they played in those places too.
